strings.name: Alvin E. Roth
strings.summary: Roth combines game theory, experiments and institutional design to study matching without prices or under constrained rules. With collaborators he improved medical-job matching, school admissions and kidney exchange, emphasizing incentives and practical detail. He shared the 2012 economics prize with Shapley and continued at Stanford. His 2026 book examines moral conflicts around market transactions.

strings.influence.rationale: Applied matching theory to school admissions, doctor allocation and kidney exchange, connecting theory with public practice.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f1.value: Born 18 December 1951 in New York, United States.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education

strings.highlights.h1.title: Matching institutions
strings.highlights.h1.text: With collaborators, applied stable matching to medical positions and school admissions.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Kidney exchange
strings.highlights.h2.text: Helped design exchanges allowing incompatible donor–recipient pairs to find compatible arrangements.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Moral Economics
strings.timeline.t1.text: Published a book on controversial transactions, market rules and moral constraints.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Economics prize
strings.timeline.t2.text: Shared the award with Lloyd Shapley for stable allocations and market-design practice.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Returned to Stanford
strings.timeline.t3.text: Left full-time Harvard duties and returned to Stanford research and teaching.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Kidney-exchange design
strings.timeline.t4.text: Developed kidney-exchange research with Tayfun Sönmez, Utku Ünver and others.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Joined Harvard
strings.timeline.t6.title: Pittsburgh faculty
strings.timeline.t6.text: Moved from Illinois to the University of Pittsburgh.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Operations-research doctorate
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed Stanford’s PhD, then taught at Illinois.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Columbia bachelor’s
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed undergraduate operations-research training at Columbia.
